description: validate_kg quality gate (docs/records/2026-10-04_kg_data_layer_fix_plan.md §3.6). severity hard = must meet target (exit 1); record = must not regress past value + tolerance (exit 2); warn = report only. A check that errors, or a metric that is None without a declared reason (unmeasured), exits 1 at any severity. value is the stored baseline, moved only toward improvement by --ratchet; direction equal moves only with --accept; direction subset stores failing probe ids, any id outside the set is a regression and --ratchet only removes ids; count_of marks a count of such an id set, always stored as len(ids) (load rejects anything else). target_from names a hard target kept in another tracked file (step0_sha = config/step0_sha.json, check_step0's baseline), never copied here. hard_from = batch where a record check becomes hard; plan_reference = the plan's live figure, kept for comparison with the measured value.

checks.title: entity_id globally unique; :Entity(entity_id) uniqueness constraint exists
checks.query: count entity_ids on >1 node (Entity or type label); SHOW CONSTRAINTS has UNIQUENESS|NODE_KEY on Entity.entity_id (snapshot: manifest.constraints)

checks.title: every Entity carries exactly one type label
checks.query: nodes labelled Entity whose type labels (Person/Place/Group/Event/Object/Theme) != 1; type-labelled nodes without :Entity

checks.title: derived edges supported by co-occurrence in their source pericope
checks.query: Entity-Entity edges except phase 3 (prior), curated, and phase-5 inverses of priors (empty source): both ends MENTIONed by source_pericope_id or by one of its chunks; an empty source_pericope_id counts as unsupported

checks.title: entity names without leading/trailing whitespace
checks.query: canonical_name != canonical_name.strip()

checks.title: three stores agree: id set, type, canonical, aliases (list), description
checks.plan_reference: id diff 0; PG description 3,045; Qdrant string aliases 9,093
checks.query: check_identity.run: PG entities and the Qdrant entity collection vs Neo4j (live only)

checks.title: P/P/G MENTIONS carry source_region and a start_pos
checks.query: non-curated MENTIONS edges to Person/Place/Group lacking source_region or start_pos

checks.title: embedding_queue sha unchanged; id prefix matches type label
checks.query: sha256(output/embedding_queue.jsonl) (snapshot: manifest.embedding_queue_sha256) must equal config/step0_sha.json files[embedding_queue.jsonl].sha256 (target_from; re-recorded by check_step0.py --record); entity_id prefix vs its single type label, minus params.id_prefix_allowlist

params.allowlist_note: group:yehehua was relabelled Person by cleanup_noise_entities.py; its id stays until entity_overrides.yaml (D9, batch 1D)

checks.title: CROSS_REFERENCES carry an explicit provenance flag
checks.query: CROSS_REFERENCES with curated IS NULL and votes IS NULL (curated-ness is only inferable from missing votes)

checks.title: relation domain/range follows config/relations/biblical_relations.yaml
checks.query: Entity-Entity edges whose (head label, tail label) the schema entry rejects; edge types missing from the schema

checks.title: Event MENTIONS set unchanged (protects the event registry)
checks.query: sorted (source label, source id, event id) of MENTIONS into Event: count and sha256; intentional change -> D1 review + --accept H10

checks.title: MENTIONS whose first position falls in the book-name region
checks.query: MENTIONS with start_pos < len(book name of the source's book)

checks.title: dictionary-substring contamination (馬利亞 in 撒馬利亞, 以利亞 in 以利亞撒 …)
checks.query: P/P/G MENTIONS whose text_span is a kg_probes.yaml substring probe and every body occurrence of it in the anchor text sits inside a longer name (probe left/right neighbour sets)

checks.title: entities mentioned under a surface that is neither canonical nor alias (homophone merges)
checks.query: stripped mention text_span outside {canonical} | aliases. Two readings, each with its own baseline (never compare one with the other): foreign_surface_entities / person = entities whose MENTIONS edge keeps such a span (the edge's first row, what live Neo4j stores; live and snapshot agree); all_forms_entities / all_forms_person = entities with such a span in ANY occurrence row (the plan's definition; 268/171 on the 2026-10 output/ JSONL), snapshot only: n/a live and on a --dump-snapshot of live, so its null baseline is first filled by --ratchet on a full snapshot

checks.title: supplementary cross-reference anchors misplaced
checks.query: supplementary CROSS_REFERENCES whose first source verse is outside the source pericope's verse_range, or first target verse outside the target's

checks.title: same canonical name under different types
checks.query: stripped canonical names owned by entities of >=2 type labels

checks.title: kinship sanity: probes, FATHER_OF contradictions, female heads, functionality
checks.query: failing R6 probes (failing_probes: ids, subset; probe_failures: their count); FATHER_OF a->b where b is asserted parent of a (FATHER_OF/MOTHER_OF b->a, SON_OF/DAUGHTER_OF a->b); FATHER_OF headed by kg_probes.yaml female_persons; share of FATHER_OF children with >=2 fathers
checks.ids_note: failing ids = the probes kg_probes.yaml marks 'fails today'; their count equals the 2026-10-04 live failures, a live run reports any id that disagrees as new/fixed

checks.title: Events mentioned by a single pericope (observe)
checks.query: Event entities whose MENTIONS (chunk -> parent) reach exactly one pericope

checks.title: junk Event/Theme/Object names (cross-reference remnants, sentence fragments)
checks.query: E/O/T canonical_name that is empty or whitespace-padded, starts with （ ( ＊ *, contains a verse ref (26‧26), or ENDS in 。，！？；」 (a comma inside a title such as 復活在我，生命在我 does not count; dash-led subtitles such as －蛙災, 15 Events, are not counted pending a decision, as in the plan's 27), minus params.allow_names

checks.title: NER positions: no duplicates; text[start:end] == span
checks.query: occurrence rows with text_id: repeated (text_id, entity, start_pos); embedding_queue text slice != text_span. n/a (declared, exit 0) when no row carries text_id and start_pos: live Neo4j keeps one position per edge, a --dump-snapshot of live likewise, and a snapshot without text_id cannot be scored

measured.origin: snapshot of output/entity_mentions.jsonl (legacy rows; positions index the full embedding_queue text)

checks.title: ambiguous or conflicting aliases
checks.query: alias surfaces listed by >=2 entities or equal to another entity's canonical_name

checks.title: CROSS_REFERENCES carrying TSK votes
checks.query: CROSS_REFERENCES with votes IS NOT NULL

checks.title: config/kg_probes.yaml facts hold
checks.hard_from: with the check each probe names
checks.query: every fact: relation / mention / event_anchor / alias / xref present or absent as declared; book_region <= max. failing (subset) is the gate: a probe outside the stored ids is a regression even when failures (the count) is unchanged
checks.ids_note: failing ids = the probes kg_probes.yaml marks 'fails today'; their count equals the 2026-10-04 live failures, a live run reports any id that disagrees as new/fixed

checks.title: label and relationship counts within ±tolerance_pct of the baseline
checks.query: Entity + type-label counts; Entity-Entity edge types, MENTIONS edges, CROSS_REFERENCES. Deliberate large moves (e.g. kinship 1,571 -> ~300) are recorded with --accept W

checks.title: export_event_registry.py --check passes against the target
checks.query: run scripts/export_event_registry.py --check with NEO4J_URI = target (live only); registry changes need a reviewed diff
